SELECT week_ending_date, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) dist_keys, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, MIN(etl_loaded_at) mn, MAX(etl_loaded_at) mx, SUM(closing_value) v
FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-09' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT fs.week_ending_date, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT (s.store_id, p.sku)) dist_nat, COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku) skus,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n900plus, SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ntest,
 SUM(fs.closing_value) v, SUM(fs.closing_units) u,
 SUM(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) negs
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM dim_product WHERE category='Paint & Decorating' AND is_current) cp ON cp.sku=p.sku
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-05' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.category AS as_was_cat, cp.category AS current_cat, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku) skus,
 SUM(fs.closing_value) v,
 SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(fs.closing_value - fs.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) value_mismatch,
 SUM(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_units,
 SUM(CASE WHEN p.delisted_on IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) delisted_rows
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-05' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND (p.category='Paint & Decorating' OR cp.category='Paint & Decorating')
GROUP BY 1,2

WITH x AS (
 SELECT fs.*, p.category AS was_cat, p.sku, p.standard_unit_cost, p.delisted_on, p.listed_from, p.valid_from, p.valid_to
 FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
 WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-05' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
), y AS (
 SELECT x.*, cp.category AS cur_cat FROM x JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=x.sku AND cp.is_current
)
SELECT was_cat, cur_cat, COUNT(*) n, SUM(closing_value) v,
 SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(closing_value - closing_units*standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) value_mismatch,
 SUM(CASE WHEN closing_units=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_units,
 SUM(CASE WHEN closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_units,
 SUM(CASE WHEN delisted_on IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) delisted_rows
FROM y WHERE was_cat='Paint & Decorating' OR cur_cat='Paint & Decorating' GROUP BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, MIN(calendar_date) AS start_date, MAX(calendar_date) AS end_date
    FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 3 GROUP BY 1, 2
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT fs.week_ending_date, SUM(fs.closing_value) AS closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Paint & Decorating' AS category,
       ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS avg_weekly_closing_stock_value_at_cost_eur, COUNT(*) AS weeks
FROM weekly
